svg.text: ToolReportGenerator → ToolAgentLoop → Gemma 4 LiteRT-LM · All on-device

Figure 2. Two-phase grounded report generation. Phase 1: tool-calling loop with persistent KV cache (max 8 rounds). Phase 2: free-text narrative on a fresh conversation seeded with pre-rendered tool outputs, eliminating placeholder contamination.
